resolved_conflicts.explanation: The 1931 report names the East Tennessee division of the state fire patrol; the Forest Lookouts page files the tower under the Tennessee Division of Forestry, District 1. The story uses the page's label. The two are probably the same state fire service, but no source says so outright.

notes_for_editor: Gone tower. No source read gives a build year, design, height, staffing, removal date or current site condition, so the story leaves those out apart from the required 'today' sentence. The 1931 item is a Kingsport Times report read only as quoted on the Forest Lookouts page. The tnlandforms code '1-8' is not explained on the page and is not interpreted. The NHLR and FFLOS Tennessee lists and the Tennessee Division of Forestry NRHP MPS PDF contain no Van Hill entry. Brief record checked: elevation 671.8 m matches 2204 ft; agency matches; status 'gone' matches. Fact-check 2026-10-10: 'East Tennessee' was removed from the story (the cited pages do not say East Tennessee); 'wildfires' was changed to 'fires'; the report date April 5, 1931 and 'District 1' were added to evidence. Search budget: 2 WebSearch calls used.
